html: † מִנִּית n.pr.loc. in Ammonite territory, site unknown (4 Rom. m. from Heshbon Euseb.Onom. 253, 33; cf. BuhlGeogr. 266);—Ju 11:33 (𝔊 ἄχρις Ἀρνών, A εἰς Σεμωειθ, 𝔊L Σεμενειθ); חִטֵּי מ׳ Ez 27:17 wheat of Minnîth (cf. wheat from Ammon 2 Ch 27:5) so Berthol, but dub.; Co conj. הִטִּים וּנְכֹאת wheat and storax.
